description:
Cancel an active offer you made on an ENS name. Returns unsigned Seaport cancel() calldata.

Only the bidder (the order's offerer) can cancel. If the offer was cross-posted to OpenSea, you signed a second 'opensea' variant — pass BOTH order hashes as alsoCancel so one tx kills both. alsoCancel takes at most 8 other hashes (do not repeat orderHash), all offers on the same name; the result lists every order the transaction cancels.

Cancelling releases the WETH you'd committed to the offer — the buyer's wallet keeps its WETH balance free to bid elsewhere once the Seaport order is invalidated.

For cancelling your own listings, use cancel_listing. Collection offers are cancelled from your offers on namewhisper.ai.

alsoCancel.description: Up to 8 more of your offers ON THE SAME NAME to cancel in the same tx (e.g. the OpenSea-variant of an NW offer). Cancelling N orders costs barely more than cancelling one.

orderHash.description: Seaport order hash of the offer to cancel (from get_name_details or the orderbook)

walletAddress.description: Wallet address of the bidder. Must match the original offerer on the order.

name: cancel_offer
